title: GENERAL PHRASE DEBIASER: DEBIASING MASKED LANGUAGE MODELS AT A MULTI-TOKEN LEVEL

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating sentence embeddings using the Sentence Embedding Association Test (SEAT) benchmark (specifically tests SEAT-6 through SEAT-8b). This measures the association between gender attributes (male vs. female words) and concept topics (career, math, art, and science) by calculating the normalized distance between their respective sentence vectors output by the models.
